summary: FB Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a third stock repurchase program authorizing up to 1,606,837 shares, or 10% of outstanding common stock. The program will be conducted on the open market, potentially via a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, with no set price or premium. The board has not named an advisor. This follows completion of two prior programs repurchasing 1,983,750 and 1,785,375 shares respectively. The repurchase is discretionary and can be suspended at any time. Watch for execution pace and market conditions; no risk-arb angle as it is a pure capital return initiative.
